entries.title: Psalms 98:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm.> O make a new song to the Lord, because he has done works of wonder; with his right hand, and with his holy arm, he has overcome.

entries.title: Psalms 98:2
segments: The Lord has given to all the knowledge of his salvation; he has made clear his righteousness in the eyes of the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 98:3
segments: He has kept in mind his mercy and his unchanging faith to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 98:4
segments: ¶Let all the earth send out a glad cry to the Lord; sounding with a loud voice, and praising him with songs of joy.

entries.title: Psalms 98:5
segments: Make melody to the Lord with instruments of music; with a corded instrument and the voice of song.

entries.title: Psalms 98:6
segments: With wind instruments and the sound of the horn, make a glad cry before the Lord, the King.

entries.title: Psalms 98:7
segments: Let the sea be thundering, with all its waters; the world, and all who are living in it;

entries.title: Psalms 98:8
segments: Let the streams make sounds of joy with their hands; let the mountains be glad together,

entries.title: Psalms 98:9
segments: Before the Lord, for he has come as judge of the earth; judging the world in righteousness, and giving true decisions for the peoples.
